# readyplayerz

> A free first-person zombie survival shooter that runs in the browser. You hold out against waves of zombies that never stop, alone or in online co-op with up to six players. No download, no account, no sign-up. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux in a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari with a keyboard and mouse. Phones and tablets aren't supported.

- Each wave is bigger than the last. Health comes back when you stay clear of zombies for a while.
- Ammo is limited: ammo boxes on the map top up each gun's reserve and are the only way to get more grenades.
- Two maps: Playground (a ruined town round a clock tower, close and quick) and Suburb (houses, a school and a strip mall in wooded hills, wide open).
- Eleven guns. Each life, alone or online, starts with the Pistol and finds the rest in weapon crates:Carbine, AK-47, SMG, Uzi, Shotgun, Double barrel, Sniper, Mosin, Pistol, Revolver, Desert Eagle.
- Online: make a room and send the invite link, or join with a four-letter room code.

## Pages

- [Play](https://readyplayerz.com/): the game itself
- [About](https://readyplayerz.com/about): how it works, the maps, guns, controls and common questions
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/ptPAsh6UR): the community, for finding people to play with
